Context: Revocation of Suspension

## Revocation of Suspension  
An order of suspension made or deemed to have been made may be modified or revoked at any time by the authority who made it (or deemed to  
have made) or any authority to which such authority is subordinate.  
- Rule 10 (5) (c).  
An order of suspension made or deemed to have been made shall not be valid after a period of ninety days unless it is extended after review, for a further period before the expiry of ninety days.
